question: Does the default (A19 profile v19) score higher when an army with fewer than two ranged stacks picks its Tier-2 artifact by rule a19-tier2-striker-v1 instead of the shipped artifact-fit-v8 choice?

candidate.rule: For an army with fewer than two ranged stacks among its known creatures (the seat's five picks at the Tier-2 decision): (1) Crown of Command when it is offered and the opponent's melee probability (a19OpponentMeleeProbability over the opposing creatures the seat may legally see, the matchup head's estimate) is below 0.8; (2) otherwise an established artifact always outranks the five whose artifact-fit-v8 score is a forecast (Archmage's Ring, Aegis of the Arcane, Quiver of Echoes, Gravechain, Last Fuse): when v8 picks one of them and an established usable artifact is on offer, the shipped policy picks among the established ones by its table. Armies with two or more ranged stacks, the beneficiary rule, the draft, setup and fight are unchanged.

control: Profile v19: artifact-fit-v8 over conditional-v1 (sniper+t2a19): the v0.7 melee win-rate table for established artifacts and a forecast score for the five newer ones (league-drafts4.ts RUSH_T2=shipped, which reproduces the registered generator's games 198/198 on the dev tasks).
why: Development on the 198 dev tasks x 5 populations (2,650 games, profile v19): every usable offered artifact was played on each task (league-drafts4.ts RUSH_T2=force:K, cells t2f{K}-{population}). The shipped choice takes Gravechain (every unit loses one movement step), Last Fuse, Aegis and Quiver of Echoes in 30% of drafts and Crown of Command in 2%; its melee table is a v0.7-era measurement in which Crown is the lowest entry. Swaps into Crown: owner +16.0, mixB12 +8.2, mixB34 +30.0, native +16.3, mirror -18.0 (about 50 tasks each); swaps out of the forecast-scored five into established artifacts: 0, +13.3, +13.5, 0, +18.6. The melee probability at the Tier-2 decision averages 0.94 in the mirror and 0.25 against native shooters. Rule and threshold were chosen AFTER seeing these data (threshold 0.8 among 0.3/0.5/0.7/0.8/0.9/always; the forecast rule after the swap split): dev estimate over all tasks +3.23 (95% +1.6 to +5.1, bootstrap clustered by base task), on changed tasks +10.16 (+4.8 to +15.5) through this analysis script (in-sample and selected). Hence this sealed bank.

populations.mirror: opponent is profile v19 (also a guard)

bank.families: the first 120 of the pool's 306 families (bank/cfH-tasks.json); no development use; audited against 453 ledgers, the five earlier rush pools, the 198 dev tasks and the running Premium collection's seeds (base 4214979728, pilot 1477276561)
bank.playedTasks: only changed tasks, both arms; on every other task the inputs are identical (make_h_bank.py asserts it), so the difference is zero

primaryEndpoint: Mean over the changed tasks of all five populations of candidate-arm minus control-arm score for the candidate seat. 95% interval from 10,000 bootstrap resamples over draft tasks (a task's populations resample together), seed 20261127, percentile 2.5 / 97.5.

gates.G1: Lower bound of the primary interval above zero.
gates.G2: No map with a changed-task estimate below -2 points and no population with a changed-task estimate below -5 points.
gates.G3: Mirror guard: the difference over all 1,080 mirror tasks is at least -2 points (the rule changes mirror games, unlike the rush rules of F and G).
gates.G4: Candidate-arm games with a quality error not more than control-arm games with one (all populations).
gates.G5: A rerun of 30 changed owner tasks (candidate arm) on the second host reproduces the digests.
gates.G6: Mean CPU per changed game of the candidate arm at most 1.25 times the control arm (both arms of a population run on the same host and tree).

adoptionRule: Adopted under the standing instruction only if G1, G2 and G3 pass; G4, G5 and G6 are recorded either way.
notClaimed: Strength against people; any effect for armies with two or more ranged stacks.

execution.runner: life-run5.ts (registered; 12/12 digests identical to life-run8.ts on dev cases)

execution.draftGenerator: league-drafts4.ts via h-drafts.sh (CANDIDATE_MODE=h1); candidate seat S:B1234:val with explore/table-a.json (RUSH_PRIOR=0.5)
